description: Cavitation (W 60 1, Schnerr-Sauer mixture): collapse of a vapour layer (W 67, 0.2 m) at the closed end of a 1 m channel under a liquid column, p_v = -10 kPa against the pressure 0 of an outlet patch on the x+ wall (C 14 21, B 441, B 412), fixed dt, 4 MPI ranks, N40=4. Short version of Regression/validation/cavitation 01 (the layer follows the piston equation rho (L-h) h'' = -(p_out - p_v)).
covers: cavitation: vapour transport with the scheme divergence, Schnerr-Sauer source, mixture density and viscosity
projection: phase-change divergence implicit in the pressure correction
density_cav face density in momentum and Poisson
patchBC pressure outlet (B 412) holding the pressure level against the phase-change divergence
REEF3D_CFD_Cavitation output, W 60-67 keywords through read_control/controlfill
